OGAKI is the social-first agency for prestige beauty.

Prestige beauty brands require highly specialized expertise. At OGAKI, we understand how to market complex formulations, we know the makeup artists, hairstylists, and dermatologists your audience trusts, and we create elevated content strategies that meet your consumer’s discerning taste. With the team's experience supporting iconic brands like Charlotte Tilbury, Diptyque, Tatcha, and Estée Lauder, we deliver sharper strategy, faster execution, and deeper impact.

But beauty expertise is only part of the equation. We build integrated programs that connect content, influence, paid, and commerce. Our team operates as one: social strategists, copywriters, video editors, graphic designers, paid experts, and influencer specialists working in sync to grow your brand across every touchpoint of the social landscape.
